questions.q: If a consumer in Nigeria discovers a pharmacy selling counterfeit (fake) antibiotics, which specific agency is empowered by the government to enforce regulations and seize the drugs?
questions.explain: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) regulates and protects public health by prohibiting the sale of counterfeit drugs and unwholesome foods.
